journey.name: save profile edits during payment setup
journey.description: Android regression for profile Save while Paykit registers payment details and refreshes allowances. Use a disposable unfunded wallet with Paykit enabled, no Pubky identity, PIN off, an English device, and reachable staging signup and homeserver services.

actions.action: Open Profile, continue through its introduction if shown, and tap "PubkyChoiceCreate"
Wait for "CreateProfileUsername", enter "Alice", dismiss the keyboard, and tap "CreateProfileSave"
Open "ProfileEdit" as soon as the profile is visible
Change the name to "Bob" and the bio to "Notes for E2E"
Add a Website link to "https://example.org" and the tag "cypherpunk"
Tap "ProfileEditSave" and verify "ProfileUpdatedToast" appears within 30 seconds
Verify the profile shows the edited name, bio, link, and tag
